title: Reckoner footer
description: A calm two-half footer under a sand hairline, split down the middle by another: the wordmark, parent-company line, small print, legal links and a short nav on the left; a 32px tagline, an underline-only email field with a square sand Subscribe button, a social link and two contact groups on the right. On phones it becomes one column in reading order. Links turn the highlight colour and underline on hover; the button turns merlot.
notes: the subscribe form is a plain HTML form (set subscribe.action); no JavaScript
the social icon is a prop: pass a neutral icon, not a network's logo, unless you have the right to use it
